The Parochial Church Council of the Ecclesiastical Parish of the Holy Trinity, 
East Ham 
Year Ending 31st December 2017 
 
Reference and Administrative Information 
The Parochial Church Council of the Ecclesiastical Parish of the Holy Trinity, East Ham is a charity 
registered with the Charity Commission for England and Wales.  
Charity Registration number: 1127847 
 
There are 3 active churches in the Parish: 
 
St Bartholomew’s Church and Centre, 292b Barking Road, London E6 3BA 
 
St Edmund, Forest Gate, 464 Katherine Road, London E7 8NP 
 
St Mary Magdalene 1 Norman Road London E6 6HN 
 
The Church is also responsible for the building at: 
St Albans Church and Christian Centre, 157a Wakefield Street London E6 1LG.  This is leased on a 
long term basis to the Pre-School Learning Alliance, and for Fellowship House on the St 
Bartholomew’s site, the ground floor of which is also long-term leased.  
  
The Parish of Holy Trinity East Ham is part of the Diocese of Chelmsford in the Church of England. 
The correspondence address is: The Parish Office, St Bartholomew’s Church and Cenre, 292b 
Barking Road London E6 3BA.  
 
Website: http://easthamparish.org.uk
